schemes.name: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation & Design)
schemes.shortDescription: Financial assistance up to ₹15 Lakh per idea for incubation, proof of concept, and design enhancement.
schemes.description: Supports innovation and technical design among MSMEs and budding entrepreneurs. Offers ₹15 Lakh per idea for incubation development and up to ₹40 Lakh for design projects.
benefits: Implemented via Ministry of MSME / Host Institutes (IITs, NITs, Incubators)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://innovative.msme.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Ministry of MSME / Host Institutes (IITs, NITs, Incubators)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (AC&ABC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / NABARD
schemes.shortDescription: Subsidized loans for agricultural graduates and entrepreneurs to set up custom hiring, processing, and input businesses.
schemes.description: Provides capital subsidy of 36% (General) and 44% (Women/SC/ST) on project cost up to ₹20 Lakh for individuals and up to ₹100 Lakh for groups of five to launch agri-ventures.
documents: Degree/Diploma in Agriculture/Allied subjects or training certificate
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.acabcmis.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MANAGE & NABARD) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.shortDescription: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through micro-enterprise establishment.
schemes.description: PMEGP provides financial assistance for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (project cost up to ₹50 Lakh) and service sector (project cost up to ₹20 Lakh). Subsidies range from 15% to 35% depending on location and category.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: General, OBC, SC, ST, Minority (All genders), Age 18–70 years
benefits: Implemented via Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Comprehensive support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools.
schemes.description: Offers PM Vishwakarma Certificate, skill training with stipend (₹500/day), toolkit grant (₹15,000), and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate with 8% interest subvention.
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MSME & MoSDE) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.shortDescription: Provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹10 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
schemes.description: Provides loans across Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh) without any collateral requirement.
benefits: Implemented via MUDRA / Commercial & Regional Rural Banks
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.mudra.org.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MUDRA / Commercial & Regional Rural Banks) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
schemes.shortDescription: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for greenfield enterprises set up by SC, ST, or Women borrowers.
schemes.description: Provides bank financing between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to encourage new business setups by SC/ST or Women entrepreneurs in manufacturing, service, or trading.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: SC, ST, General, OBC, Minority (All genders), Age 18–70 years
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.standupmitra.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (SIDBI & Commercial Banks) or bank for verification

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Micro-Credit for Street Vendors)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
schemes.shortDescription: Affordable working capital loan for street vendors to resume their livelihoods in urban areas.
schemes.description: Provides working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy on regular repayments and cashbacks on digital transactions.
benefits: Implemented via MoHUA & Urban Local Bodies (ULB)
documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card from ULB
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MoHUA & Urban Local Bodies (ULB)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
schemes.shortDescription: Financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, and market entry.
schemes.description: Provides up to ₹20 Lakh grant for proof of concept/prototype and up to ₹50 Lakh debt/convertible debenture investment for scaling up.
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://seedfund.startupindia.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (DPIIT & Incubators) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
schemes.shortDescription: Enables collateral-free credit facilities up to ₹5 Crore for new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises.
schemes.description: Provides credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for micro-enterprises and women/SC/ST entrepreneurs, allowing commercial banks to disburse loans up to ₹5 Crore without demanding physical collateral or third-party guarantees.
benefits: Implemented via SIDBI & Member Lending Institutions (MLIs)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.cgtmse.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (SIDBI & Member Lending Institutions (MLIs)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.shortDescription: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10 Lakh for setting up or upgrading micro food processing units.
schemes.description: Supports individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, and FPOs in establishing food processing businesses (dairy products, bakery, spices, pickles, packaging, fruit processing). Provides 35% capital subsidy (max ₹10 Lakh per individual unit) with only 10% beneficiary contribution.
benefits: Implemented via MoFPI & State Nodal Agencies (SNA)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://pmfme.mofpi.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MoFPI & State Nodal Agencies (SNA)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / NBCFDC
schemes.shortDescription: Concessional micro-credit up to ₹1.40 Lakh at 4% annual interest rate for women entrepreneurs.
schemes.description: Provides micro-finance directly to women belonging to backward classes and underprivileged communities to start small businesses, beauty parlours, tailoring units, and grocery shops at an affordable 4% per annum interest rate.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: OBC, SC, ST, Minority (Female, Other), Age 18–55 years
benefits: Implemented via NBCFDC & State Channelising Agencies (SCAs)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.nbcfdc.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (NBCFDC & State Channelising Agencies (SCAs)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
schemes.shortDescription: 3% interest subvention on term loans up to 90% of project cost for dairy, poultry, meat, and animal feed plants.
schemes.description: Incentivizes private enterprises, MSMEs, and FPOs to establish dairy processing plants, meat processing facilities, veterinary vaccine manufacturing, and animal feed plants with 3% interest subvention and up to 25% credit guarantee.
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash flows
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://ahidf.udyamimitra.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (DAHD & SIDBI) or bank for verification

schemes.name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Up to 80% subsidy (₹5 Lakh per unit) on Zero Defect Zero Effect certification and clean manufacturing technology.
schemes.description: Encourages MSMEs to adopt Zero Defect Zero Effect manufacturing practices. Provides financial assistance: 80% subsidy for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises (with an additional 10% for Women/SC/ST owned units).
benefits: Implemented via Quality Council of India (QCI) & MSME
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://zed.msme.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Quality Council of India (QCI) & MSME) or bank for verification

schemes.name: SAMRIDH Scheme (MeitY Startup Accelerator)
schemes.shortDescription: Up to ₹40 Lakh matching funding support for tech and software product startups through accelerators.
schemes.description: Aims to scale software product startups by providing matching funding up to ₹40 Lakh along with mentorship, customer access, and global investor connections in sectors like SaaS, Fintech, Healthtech, and Edtech.
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://meitystartuphub.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (MeitY Startup Hub (MSH)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIRAC BIG)
schemes.shortDescription: Up to ₹50 Lakh equity-free grant for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and healthcare innovators.
schemes.description: Provides grant-in-aid up to ₹50 Lakh over 18 months to enable researchers, entrepreneurs, and startups to establish proof-of-concept for innovative biotech, medical devices, bio-agriculture, and pharma technologies.
benefits: Implemented via Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://birac.nic.in/big.php
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting Young & Aspiring Innovators)
schemes.shortDescription: Up to ₹10 Lakh grant for converting innovative technical ideas into physical working prototypes.
schemes.description: Supports young innovators and early-stage hardware/deeptech startups by providing grants up to ₹10 Lakh to build functional prototypes with access to state-of-the-art PRAYAS fabrication labs and incubator mentorship.
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://dst.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (DST & PRAYAS Centres (IITs/IIMs/NITs)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX)
schemes.shortDescription: Grants up to ₹1.5 Crore (and ₹10 Crore for iDEX Prime) for defence, aerospace, and cybersecurity innovation.
schemes.description: Engages startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators to develop advanced defense solutions (drones, AI surveillance, tactical communications, aerospace tech) for the Indian Armed Forces with direct procurement opportunities.
documents: Technical Solution Proposal for Armed Forces Challenge
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://idex.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO)) or bank for verification

schemes.name: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
schemes.shortDescription: Grants up to ₹1 Crore to set up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and rural agro-tech enterprises.
schemes.description: Promotes innovation and rural entrepreneurship by establishing business incubators. Provides up to ₹100 Lakh for setting up LBIs and up to ₹1 Crore seed capital for agro-rural business commercialization and skilling.
benefits: Implemented via Ministry of MSME & NSIC / KVIC
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://aspire.msme.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (Ministry of MSME & NSIC / KVIC) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
schemes.shortDescription: Grants up to ₹2.5 Crore to ₹5 Crore for organizing traditional artisans and craftspersons into competitive clusters.
schemes.description: Provides financial support to organize traditional artisans (Khadi, Village Industries, Coir, Bamboo, Handloom) into clusters. Offers up to ₹2.5 Crore for Regular Clusters (500 artisans) and up to ₹5 Crore for Major Clusters for common facility centers, modern machinery, and packaging.
benefits: Implemented via KVIC, Coir Board & Nodal Agencies
documents: Land documentation for Common Facility Centre
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://sfurti.msme.gov.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (KVIC, Coir Board & Nodal Agencies) or bank for verification

schemes.name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy for Technology Upgradation (CLCSS)
schemes.shortDescription: 15% upfront capital subsidy up to ₹15 Lakh for micro and small manufacturing enterprises modernizing plant & machinery.
schemes.description: Facilitates technology upgradation by providing a 15% upfront capital subsidy (up to ₹15 Lakh on institutional credit up to ₹1 Crore) for Micro and Small Enterprises in designated manufacturing sub-sectors to install state-of-the-art energy-efficient equipment.
benefits: Implemented via SIDBI, NABARD & Commercial Banks
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://my.msme.gov.in/mymsme/Scheme.aspx
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (SIDBI, NABARD & Commercial Banks) or bank for verification

schemes.name: National SC-ST Hub - Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy (SCLCSS)
schemes.shortDescription: 25% upfront capital subsidy up to ₹25 Lakh on institutional loans for SC/ST MSME entrepreneurs.
schemes.description: Provides 25% upfront capital subsidy (maximum ₹25 Lakh) on institutional credit up to ₹1 Crore for purchasing plant, machinery, and equipment for SC/ST-owned enterprises, along with marketing, capacity building, and 4% mandatory public procurement facilitation.
benefits: Implemented via National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC)
applicationProcess: Visit the official portal at https://www.scsthub.in/
Register with Aadhaar and enter personal & business details
Upload required documents and project report
Submit to nodal agency (National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC)) or bank for verification
